findings.finding: Existing message/recovery broad fallback maps a local budget.reserve exception to singleton public PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE before provider dispatch. New telemetry initially would have inferred a provider cause from that local failure.
findings.resolution: provider_entered captured only immediately before existing provider boundary; predispatch budget exception/refusal supplies no provider code. Existing public response, authoritative zero settlement and replay preserved.
findings.independentValidation: Two actual Moto consumer budget-reserve exception cases assert no provider calls, no provider-specific terminal metadata, unchanged replay and zero used/reserved accounting.

findings.finding: A helper return drawn from global finite code set but incompatible with processing outcome could reach authoritative settlement and change business behavior.
findings.resolution: All three consumers enforce exact outcome-specific codes and unavailable singleton equality with actual source facts, swallowing optional helper exceptions/missing/invalid results.
findings.independentValidation: Wrong-listed code matrix across three consumers, malformed/exception helpers, disabled flags and source-singleton disagreement probes.
findings.historicalEvidenceLimit: Both findings were identified by static source counterexamples and fixed before the first retained independent regression run; no historical failing test execution is claimed.

validation.services: Local Moto and injected synthetic provider/budget only
validation.testCaptureNote: This run collected20 independent cases before15 final source-singleton cases were added.

conclusions: Only existing three validated consumer settlement boundaries receive optional finite metadata; no changes to contracts, response schemas, authoritative accounting/CAS, authentication, replay or provider calls.
Default-off uses only original result_summary keyword; exact boolean True is required before helper import/call.

Generic partial and failed facts do not assert provider root cause. Unavailable provider metadata requires one recognized source code and actual boundary entry; mixed, budget, absent and unknown cases remain unrecorded.
Freshness fallback retains original settlement retry/no provider retry and recomputes only safe finite metadata.
Optional helper failures cannot alter validated summary identity or add raw diagnostics; independent tests verify original result object preserved.

Accepted/terminal source events remain reconciled by logical ref and existing reducer; duplicate facts do not inflate denominator. No provider attempts, duration, costs or external provider provenance are invented.
limits: Source-only review and local Moto tests; no AWS/auth/endpoints/runtime/provider/emulator or installed mobile actions.
No actual operations producer activation, new flag, resource, handler, schedule, store delivery or cost implementation.
producerCoverage remains not_qualified; full SEC237 requirements including attempts/cost/deletion/expiry/backup/actual deployment/delivery remain open as applicable.
SEC198 requirements were inspected for compatibility only; this telemetry slice does not implement or complete minimum-version/service messaging.
Final docs, full frozen suite and package evidence require separate handoff review.
